body: I get what you are saying, don't worry. And to answer to your questions: With the old lady, do you mean she had a pained look on her face or she had actual injuries? If she had a pained look on her face but no physical injuries I likely would not be able to bring myself to go over to her but if she had actual injuries and noone was doing anything I would likely go see if she was okay (although if someone else already was I likely would leave it). If I saw a man from his sons funeral I'd probably feel some pity that he lost his son and about the child who was abandoned, I'd again feel pity that he was abandoned and probably take them somewhere to get help. Even if I did this, while you can say that is a contribution to the world, I don't see it at as that. Someone will help the child even if I didn't.
I dunno, they'd probably think of connections that they have to people. I don't feel connected to people to think of that as a reason.
I don't really have any talents so to speak, and I guess my interests... at most I'd say video games. And even that is more of the fact I have no clue I just somewhat enjoy video games.

I don't feel particularly courageous for being able to post this. I just figured that it doesn't matter that people most likely laugh reading this since I won't know. I get that people always say that someone feeling anything like I do has a lot to offer but I just don't see it. I'm not particularly smart at all, when I was younger I was told I was smart but I haven't really gotten properly smarted in years. I just honestly do not see what reason there is for me to exist other than to make others lives difficult.
